goal.short: Keep Radoslav Korolev busy with real work for Arcane Orders, too busy to gather friends of their own.
goal.long: Clear the debt to Tatiana Andreyev without anyone ever learning there was one.

goal.short: Take one piece of business from Merchant Guilds and bring it to Craft Guilds.
goal.long: Outlast Radomir Bykov in Craft Guilds, and be ready when the place falls empty.

goal.short: See someone who wronged them lose face in public this season.
goal.long: Build up stores large enough that the work at the smelter never stops for lack of supply again.
